faceparse-bisenet-r18-q8.onnx — face parsing model used by studio.html (hair / face / neck / clothes layers)

Source:   https://github.com/yakhyo/face-parsing  (release "weights", file resnet18.onnx, 53 MB fp32)
          BiSeNet (Yu et al., "BiSeNet: Bilateral Segmentation Network for Real-time Semantic Segmentation", ECCV 2018),
          architecture after https://github.com/zllrunning/face-parsing.PyTorch (MIT)
Changes:  auxiliary outputs removed, batch fixed to 1, ONNX shape inference, dynamic quantization of the
          weights to uint8 with onnxruntime.quantization.quantize_dynamic (13.2 MB). No retraining.
Input:    1x3x512x512 RGB, ImageNet mean/std;  Output: 1x19x512x512 logits (CelebAMask-HQ label order:
          background, skin, l_brow, r_brow, l_eye, r_eye, eye_g, l_ear, r_ear, ear_r, nose, mouth, u_lip, l_lip,
          neck, neck_l, cloth, hair, hat)

NOTE on training data: the weights were trained on CelebAMask-HQ
(https://github.com/switchablenorms/CelebAMask-HQ), whose dataset terms allow non-commercial research and
educational use only. Review this before commercial deployment; if it is not acceptable, delete this file and
the .onnx — studio.js then falls back to the built-in colour-clustering parser (StudioCore.heuristicParse).
